src: Vérifiez toujours le nom et le numéro du bénéficiaire avant de confirmer un transfert.
Always verify the beneficiary name and number before confirming a transfer.

src: Consultez votre solde et lancez un transfert en toute sécurité.
Check your balance and start a secure transfer.
entries.tgt: Yén mbi mɛ́ wɔ bhɔ́ŋ nɛ́ bho nɛtum-mbi ya nɛbhabharí.

src: Choisissez le type de transfert et le montant. Les frais sont calculés automatiquement.
Choose the transfer type and amount. Fees are calculated automatically.

Mbi mɛ́ bɛ́ bhɔ́ŋ ansɛm nɛtum-mbi

src: Renseignez les informations du destinataire. Vérifiez toujours le numéro avant de valider.
Enter the recipient details. Always verify the number before confirming.
entries.tgt: Chwe mɛnyɨŋ mɛ́ nnɛ-nsɔt mbi. Yén nimba mpók nkɛm ambɨ bɛ́ kǎ.

src: Ce bénéficiaire n'a jamais été utilisé sur ce compte. Vérifiez le numéro avant de continuer.
This beneficiary has never been used on this account. Verify the number before continuing.
entries.tgt: Nnɛ-nsɔt mbi ɔ a bhɨ́kɨ́ sɔt mbi o ɛkyɛbhɛ́-mbi eyi. Yén nimba ambɨ bɛ́ chɔŋ ambɨ.
Ntí-ndak ya nɛtum-mbi / Ɛsɨŋɨ (mbák wɔ kwak)

src: J'ai vérifié le nom et le numéro du bénéficiaire.
I have verified the beneficiary name and phone number.
entries.tgt: Mmɛ mḿbʉ yén mbɨ́n nɛ́ nimba ya fon ya nnɛ-nsɔt mbi.

src: Vérifiez les informations avant de confirmer le transfert.
Check the details before confirming the transfer.
entries.tgt: Yén mɛnyɨŋ mɛ́nkɛm ambɨ bɛ́ kǎ nɛtum-mbi.

src: Je confirme que les informations ci-dessus sont correctes.
I confirm the information above is correct.
entries.tgt: Ntum mbi / Mmɛ kǎ bɛ́ mɛnyɨŋ mɛ́ amfay mɛ́ ɛ́kway.

src: Votre transfert a été envoyé avec succès.
Your transfer has been sent successfully.
entries.tgt: Nɛtum-mbi ya wɔ nɛ́ tum sáyrí-sáyri.

ya ɛsyɛ́ ya wɔ ɛ́ nɛn nɛ́ yɨ

src: Collect Mobile Money with no-code tools or one API, track every franc in a single dashboard, and register your business when you're ready.
entries.tgt: Sɔt Mobile Money nɛ́ bɛnyu titi kɔdɛ kɛ́ API mɔ́t, yén mbi mɛ́nkɛm o ɛkyɛbhɛ́ mɔ́t, nɛ́ ghokó mbɨ́n ya ɛsyɛ́ ya wɔ mbák wɔ kɔkɔ.

src: Trusted by businesses of all sizes

entries.tgt: Bɛ́ ghokó yɨ ɛ́ nɛn nɛ́ wɔ

src: Start collecting today with no setup. When you're ready, we help you move from informal to fully registered, and we handle the tax side of things.
entries.tgt: Bho nɛsɔt mbi nɛ́nɛ titi ákwɔ. Mbák wɔ kɔkɔ, sɛ́ bhɔk wɔ ghokó mbɨ́n ya ɛsyɛ́ ya wɔ, nɛ́ sɛ́ yén ndak ya tákisi.

src: Fast integration and clear docs to accept Mobile Money on your platform.
entries.tgt: Nɛchwe áyák-áyák nɛ́ mɛnyɨŋ mɛ́ ɛ́kway bɛ́ sɔt Mobile Money o ɛkyɛbhɛ́ ya wɔ.
Bɛnzɨ bɛ́ ákwɔ nɛ́ bɛsyɛ́ bɛ́ intanɛtɛ

src: Collect instantly without building a website or app.
entries.tgt: Sɔt mbi áyák-áyák titi kʉ websayt kɛ́ app.

src: Income, sales and expenses tracked in one place.
entries.tgt: Mbi mɛ́ chwe, ɛsyɛ́ nɛ́ mbi mɛ́ fɛrɛ́ bɛ́ yén o nji mɔ́t.

src: Register your business without the tax headaches.
entries.tgt: Ghokó mbɨ́n ya ɛsyɛ́ ya wɔ titi ndak ya tákisi.

src: Your business, powered by smarter payments
entries.tgt: Ɛsyɛ́ ya wɔ, ɛ́ bhɔ́ŋ ngʉ nɛ́ bákwɔ bɛ́ fɛ́

src: Gather contributions, donations and funds with a link. No screenshots, no manual balancing. Just share and collect.
entries.tgt: Kɔt mbi nɛ́ nzɨ ya ákwɔ. Titi fɔtɔ ya skrin, titi pay nɛ́ bhɔ́. Ká ghap nɛ́ sɔt.
Nimba ya MTN MoMo kɛ́ OM

src: Sell tickets online, manage bookings and attendance, and see real-time analytics.
entries.tgt: Kʉ ɛsyɛ́ ya bɛtikiti o intanɛtɛ, yén bɛchwe nɛ́ nɛpay o nɛ́nɛ eyi.

src: Run competitions and pageants online with paid votes, live results and leaderboards.
entries.tgt: Kʉ bɛghɔ́k o intanɛtɛ nɛ́ bɛyap bɛ́ ákwɔ, mɛnyɨŋ o nɛ́nɛ eyi nɛ́ nɛnɛnɛ ya bɛfori.

src: Create branded invoices, get paid with proof, and keep records for years.
entries.tgt: Ghokó mɛnyɨŋ mɛ́ ákwɔ, sɔt mbi nɛ́ ɛsɨŋɨ, nɛ́ bhɔ́ŋ mɛnyɨŋ bɛyɨ bɛ́nkɛm.
